findings.issue: The new subprocess wrapper decodes Node's UTF-8 output with the platform default encoding. On CP950 Windows the reader thread raises UnicodeDecodeError even on green runs; a failing Node test loses its diagnostics and raises TypeError while concatenating stdout. Reproduced with an actual failing Node test under a forced CP950 default.

summary: Reviewed #78 against #74 and the Phase 3 checklist; the single generated bundle supplies the required code/data consistency boundary. Fixed one low-severity Windows encoding defect in the Python test wrapper, with a deterministic failing Node test proving red before the fix and preserving UTF-8 diagnostics after it. All 139 pytest tests and 5 Node pair tests pass; JavaScript syntax and regenerated Analytics consistency checks also pass.
